title: THIRTY YEARS RAW (Vault Opens)
style:
alt-rock anthem, raw honest male vocal NZ/AU accent, acoustic and electric guitar blend, emotional weight of time and release, builds from intimate verse to open anthemic chorus, the sound of a vault opening, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 98 BPM
```
lyrics:
```
[INTRO — acoustic guitar, raw]
Thirty years.
In a box.
Opens today.

[VERSE 1]
I wrote the first one when I didn't know
What I was starting, where it'd go
Kept it quiet, kept it safe
Kept it waiting for the right place

Scared to love
Scared to release
Scared the songs would fall apart
Instead of giving peace

[CHORUS]
Thirty years raw
Vault opens today
Thirty years raw
Birthday gives them away
ENAMOUR — Inspire
The songs finally breathe
Thirty years raw
Reaching underneath

[VERSE 2]
BACK ON, PLASTASINE, AWAY, BE FREE
FOR EVER, ONLY YOU — all of it for me
IMAGINARY FRIENDS — the ones who stayed
GRAYLANDS where the real ones were made

[OUTRO]
Thirty years.
Raw.
Open.
Now.
```
